verses.text: “Call upon Me; I will respond to you.”

end.text: 17 takes to film one sunset. Not one du'a before it set.
end.gold: Before Maghrib today: raise your hands. Ask Him.

captions: Friday, 4:40 p.m. The sea. The sky turning gold.
Today you asked your phone for everything. Weather. Way. Time.
Then the sun touches the water. And it's gone.
A whole Friday. And you never asked Him for anything.
5:00 p.m. Cold water on your hands. Then your face.
The last light of Friday. You finally raise your hands.
No filter. No second take. Just: “Ya Allah.”

post.caption:
17 takes to film one sunset. Not one du'a before it set. 🌅

“Call upon Me; I will respond to you.” (40:60)

It's Friday. Before Maghrib today: put the phone down, raise your hands, and ask Him. No filter needed. 🤲
